Name: Boho Rug Collection
Author: inmognito
Description:
Since I'm on a boho kick at the moment (see also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13757]Boho Bed Collection[/url]) here's a collection of hippy/boho style rugs for Alternative textures. I'll probably add more as I'm having too much fun right now.

At present these only replace the small 2 by 3 rugs, but I hope to add textures for some of the other rug sizes too.

[b]Installation
[/b][list=1]
[*]Unzip the file
[*]Paste into the Mods folder
[*]Buy the paint bucket from Robin and go to town on your rugs.

[/list]
